plain.li: When I came here, we ate standing up because there was nowhere to sit.
There was nothing on this spot when I first came.
The first winter here, we had half of what we have now.
I remember when there were only a handful of us.
[winter] Our first winter was colder than this one, I'm sure of it.
[tribal] In the first days we all slept round one fire.
[spacer] We had almost none of this gear when we started.

warm.li: We've come a long way since the first days, all of us.

blunt.li: It was harder at the start, believe me.

cheerful.li: You should have seen this place when I came, it was a mess.

gloomy.li: Not everyone from the early days is still with us.

cold.li: We built the stores first, and everything else after.

plain.li: Settling in all right, are you?
The first days are the hardest, it gets easier.
If you can't find something, ask me.
Good to have a new face around here.
[eating] Sit with us if you like, there's room.
[tribal] There's always room at the fire for a new one.

warm.li: You'll feel at home here soon, I promise.

blunt.li: Ask me anything you need to know about this place.

cheerful.li: A new face, how nice, welcome.

gloomy.li: I remember how lonely my first days here were.

cold.li: Learn where the stores are first, the rest comes later.

plain.li: I'm keeping count, so don't try anything.
Best of three, then.
That one doesn't count, I wasn't ready.
One more game, and this time I win.
I'm watching your hands.
[evening|night] Last game of the night, and it's mine.

gloomy.li: Lost again, I don't believe it.

cold.li: You make the same mistake every game.

plain.li: No sulking at the table, please.
Whatever it is, talk it over after the meal.
If you two are still cross, sort it out before the food gets cold.
Nobody eats angry at this table.
Pass the bread and make up, both of you.
[lowtech] Share the bowl and the quarrel's over, that's how it's done.

warm.li: We're all on the same side here, you know.

cheerful.li: Smiles at the table, everyone, come on.

cold.li: Arguments spoil the meal, so let's not.

plain.li: Come here, I'll show you how.
Ask me anything, I've got time.
What have you got there?
Careful with that, here, hold it like this.
Did you learn something new today?
[rain] Mind the puddles, little one.

warm.li: You're doing very well, you know.

blunt.li: Watch closely, I'll do it once more.

cheerful.li: Who wants to hear a story later?

gloomy.li: Stay close where I can see you.

cold.li: Good question, and here's the answer.

plain.li: What was it like when you were little?
Can I help you with that?
Show me how you do it.
Tell me again about the old days.
Where did you learn that?
[evening|night] Will you tell me a story before bed?

warm.li: I like being with you best.

cold.li: Explain it step by step, please.
